result.summary: Mostly the page looks intact, but the main feed is being clipped by the fixed bottom navigation, and some horizontal cards are cut off at the screen edges.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the content feed, cutting off the lower restaurant card and making part of it visually inaccessible.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so the last items clear the fixed tab bar and remain fully visible.

issues.description: Several carousel items are partially clipped at the right edge, including the restaurant card title in the "Fastest near you" row.
issues.suggestion: Increase side padding or use clearer carousel spacing so edge items aren’t awkwardly truncated, or make the horizontal-scroll affordance more obvious.
